training_source: CREMA-D, ESD, MELD, M3ED and Singaporean speech

columns.audio_path: audio file, relative to the emotion_recognition/ folder
columns.acted_emotion: ground truth: the emotion each actor was asked to portray, from the second digit of the file name
columns.listener_vote: the majority vote of the 40 listeners who rated each clip (`Corpus information.xlsx`); a tie counts every tied emotion; 'a or b' is a tie
columns.prediction: model prediction: the most probable of the 7 emotions evaluated (neutral, happy, angry, fearful, sad, disgusted, surprised)
columns.prediction_all_classes: model prediction: the most probable of all 7 model classes
columns.correct_acted_or_listener: whether prediction equals acted_emotion or the listener_vote (any emotion of a tie)
columns.p_*: model probability of each of its 7 classes (they add up to 1)
